claim: For the Li–Ma multiple-exposure SIR subsystem \(\dot S=A-dS-(\beta_1+\beta_0 I)SI\), \(\dot I=(\beta_1+\beta_0 I)SI-\rho I\), with \(A,d,\rho>0\) and \(\rho>d\), at \(\beta_1=d\rho/A\) and \(\beta_0=d\rho^2/A^2\), the disease-free equilibrium \(E_0=(A/d,0)\) is globally asymptotically stable on the nonnegative quadrant. Every interior solution \(I(0)>0\) satisfies \[I(t)=\frac{A}{\sqrt{2}\,\rho^{3/2}}t^{-1/2}+\frac{A(d-\rho)}{2d\rho^2}t^{-1}+O(t^{-3/2}\log t),\] and \[S(t)-\frac{A}{d}=-\frac{A}{d\sqrt{2\rho}}t^{-1/2}+\frac{A(\rho-d)}{2d^2\rho}t^{-1}+O(t^{-3/2}\log t).\] In the physical infection coordinate the local center equation is \[\dot I=-\frac{\rho^3}{A^2}I^3+\frac{\rho^4(d-\rho)}{A^3d}I^4+O(I^5).\] Thus the codimension-two disease-free threshold is an attracting cubic degeneracy rather than a saddle-node in the usual scalar normal-form sense; the published cubic term is retained as prior input, while global attraction, the quartic coefficient, and the two-term decay law are the new claim.
integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the model, equilibrium theorem, center-manifold calculation, and global phase-portrait sections. The packaged symbolic checker replays the new algebra from the printed vector field. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact critical parameter only; interior asymptotics require \(I(0)>0\); no claim about nearby endemic Bogdanov–Takens branches or transient maxima; literature search cannot prove universal novelty.
title: Global attraction and two-term critical relaxation at the multiple-exposure disease-free degeneracy
